name: Nebula
status_note: The official site lists upcoming events for Oct 20, 23, 24 and 27, 2026, with live SpeakeasyGo ticket and table links. The site's FAQ page still says 'Coming soon'.

dress.detail: The official SpeakeasyGo event page bans sports attire, shorts, tank tops or sleeveless shirts, sweatpants, flip-flops and slides for men. For women it bans flip-flops, slides, sneakers, sandals and open-toe shoes, and encourages dresses and heels. Admission is at door staff's discretion.

getting_in.value: Buy tickets or book a table on SpeakeasyGo via the official site. Table bookings also by text or email to reservations. The door has final say.

subway.value: 42 St-Bryant Park (B/D/F/M) and 5 Av (7) are about 2-3 min away; Times Sq-42 St is about 5 min

sources.name: Nox Agency - Nebula (about 5 min to Times Square)

skip_if: You want a big dance floor: reviewers say much of the floor is given over to reserved tables and VIP areas, and it is a bottle-service club.
You go by ratings: it has about 2 stars on Yelp from roughly 99 reviews.
